config.intent: Evaluate the incremental benefit and cost of explicit business-to-physical mappings over a complete physical schema on supported financial requests.

decision.primary: Paired exact-column, typed-value, order-aware Gold result agreement; guardrail rejections remain failures.
decision.success: Advance only if business_mapping gains at least 2 of 12 paired outcomes, regresses 0, and total prompt+completion tokens are at most 1.5 times the control on complete pairs.
decision.reject: Reject this configuration if business_mapping has fewer correct paired outcomes or exceeds 1.5 times the control token cost without a correctness gain.
decision.otherwise: Inconclusive; no claim of statistical significance or a general ontology effect.
decision.limits: This is a new model/protocol arm, not a rerun of the earlier full/retrieved FIBO comparison. All six requests are supported; refusal-policy and legal-control cases require their own experiment. Both arms receive the same physical names, property types, edge directions, user parameters, expected columns and harness rules. Only business_mapping receives the same fixed business vocabulary mapping; no Gold query or values are included. The mapping is local/partial FIBO projection, not formal ontology reasoning or FIBO conformance.

cases.seed: MATCH (p:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}) MATCH (p)-[:APPLY]->(:Loan {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}) RETURN a.acct_no AS acct_no ORDER BY acct_no LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[r:REPAY]->(l:Loan {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}) WITH a, l, sum(r.amount) AS repaid WHERE repaid < l.principal * $repaid_ratio RETURN a.acct_no AS acct_no ORDER BY acct_no LIMIT 1

MATCH (:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}) RETURN c.id AS company_id ORDER BY company_id LIMIT 1

semantic_source.note: Referenced terms were checked against the pinned official release. Mappings remain explicit FinBench projections/proxies, not a claim that the synthetic graph conforms to FIBO.

summary.scope: Preregistered exploratory pilot; no significance or general ontology claim.
